title: Register as a supplier on buy.nsw
summary: This page explains how eligible businesses can register as a supplier on buy.nsw to potentially supply goods or services to NSW government agencies.
intro:
Buy.nsw is an online procurement system used by NSW government agencies to connect buyers with suppliers.

If you have an eligible business no matter how big or small, you may be able to supply goods and/or services to NSW government agencies.

who_can_apply: Must be a registered business with an Australian Business Number (ABN).

more_info.text: Your Supplier Hub account and profile are based on the ABN you provide during registration. If you have more than one ABN, the various companies are supported under your single registration/profile.
You are not permitted to change the ABN of an active profile.
All NSW Government suppliers must be registered with Supplier Hub

faqs.a: Buy.nsw is an online procurement system used by NSW government agencies to connect buyers with suppliers.

faqs.q: Who can register as a supplier?
faqs.a: You must be a registered business with an Australian Business Number (ABN).

faqs.q: How do I register as a supplier?
faqs.a: You can register by selecting the ‘Register online’ button, creating your account, and completing your profile.
